title: GoCkpt: Gradient-Assisted Multi-Step overlapped Checkpointing for Efficient LLM Training
selection_reason: Overlaps checkpoint transfer across multiple training steps and restores consistent checkpoint state on CPU while optimizing GPU-CPU and SSD persistence throughput; relevant to durable training-state I/O.
